text: Wasn't expecting it, but the 1911 Grill has a very good 8oz. Angus burger - Wow!  I may take some time off from eating for awhile?

This a small, family owned, take out only place.  They have chicken and fries, and not much else.  We had chicken tenders, wings and regular fries.  We had to wait while they cooked it up, so everything was piping hot.  It was good, really good.

It wasn't fancy, no sit down, on street parking only.  If you don't want to wait, you should call in your order first.  Let's say it again, the food was good and it was hot out of the fryer.

The Just Sauce is kind of sweet and sour, and BBQ at the same time.  There are lot of choices, need to find which one is right for you.

The food is amazing, the staff is even better! We got the grilled steak, black beans and rice, salad, goat,tamales and everything was so savory and everything had its own good flavor. Nothing bland at all. Can't wait to go back!
Another run of the mill business in Arizona with subpar service and blasé management. Wrote to corporate about my terrible experience.. have yet to hear back

This is a nice place to eat at, good food, but not so great service. Before we even came in we made a reservation, then was told we were on a clock for how long we could stay. The waiter was very quick, and left as soon as he was done talking, and didn't even come back very often, if at all without me stopping him to get simple things, like ketchup or other sauces. But awesome food! Just need some work on the service part of the restaurant.

It's a good decent steakhouse. Ambience is just ok.
The food was good. Maybe a bit too overpriced. 
We shared a crab appetizer which was great. 
Main meal was a filet mignon with an excellent sauce bearnaise. Hubby had a bone in ribeye. 
Both steaks were prepared to perfection. 
Our sides were hashbrowns with gruyere cheese which was ok and we shared a Greek salad which was ok. I say ok to the hashbrowns & greek salad because they were good but not outstanding. The steaks though were delicious and perfect.

Perennial best of Philadelphia winner for their steak sandwiches. A hole in the wall smaller than most people's living rooms.  Before the pandemic, they sat about 10 at a counter.  By far most orders are take out. For my money, their steak sandwiches are too big. If I get one, I order light meat. But to be honest I haven't heard any complaints from steak sandwich lovers. Classic Philadelphia cheesesteak roll, lots of meat, chopped fine, raw or fried onions, your choice of cheese. I've been a fan of their Italian hoagies for more than 40 years. I get mine with crushed red pepper relish on the side. Only downside is there is almost always a line. And they only take cash. An authentic Philly neighborhood classic.
Great cuppa Joe. I love their vanilla latte with their almond very substitute. It is amazing. Also have their caramel latte, but I do have to say vanilla is my favorite.

Amazing pizza!! I had the plain Jane pizza and I added spinach and it was so good. The tomato sauce was probably the best tomato sauce I've ever had on a "fast food" pizza. They have lots of cool options for toppings as well (a whole egg??). Went with my friend who is celiac and she says it is the best gluten free pizza she's ever tasted and gets her GF stamp of approval . Will be coming back

Food was very good.  We has the lobster dumplings which were excellent & highly recommend. The wedge salad was very good-3 mall wedges each prepared a blue cheese, ranch and thousand island dressing respectively.  Entrees grouper and snapper were nicely presented.   Okra in snapper entree was described as fried, but was actually slimy which was a bit of a turn off but everything else was delicious.  Although we skipped dessert, we were treated to a sweet bite/happy birthday plate & candle.  Very nice atmosphere and decor.  Service was very attentive and our table was ready as reserved.  However,  we love to sit at the restaurant bars before dinner so we usually arrive early for that which we did but found out that we had to reserve a spot at the bar. Even though I explained that I had a reservation for a table, we could not sit and enjoy a drink. So we stood for 44 mins until our table was ready. It turned out there was a section of the bar held for non-diners but we were not provided with that option.  Unfortunately, it created a lot of confusion and animosity.

I always refer to Pizza Haven as Brandon's hidden gem. And I literally mean hidden gem besince it's tucked away behind the Walgreens on the corner of Parsons and Highway 60. It's at the far end of the strip center adjacent to the parking lot of Walgreens, where Subway is located.

This pizzeria seems to head been built to handle social distancing. right now the inside counter and few tables are closed you pick up your pizza order from the outside window. They have very clear signage for social distancing and marked off X's on the sidewalk to assist in safe waiting. 

And now to the important stuff the quality of their pizza is bar none! I've been calling in my pizza order @ Pizza Haven for years. My order is always ready when they quote me a time. My family loves the Gator Special, consisting of two large pizzas with one topping - we get a cheese and pepperoni, garlic knots or chicken wings and a 2 liter of soda. We ALWAYS order the knots! Those garlic knots are literally the best garlic knots we've had since we moved to the area 15 years ago!! Do not order pizza from Pizza Haven without adding garlic knots you will knot regret it... See what I did there ;)

Walked into a great place . This is a cool litttle
Tiki bar . The staff was great the drinks are just as good .
Also got a Burrito Al Pastor for lunch it was more than enough and definitely delicious.  The Guacamole is very tasty.

I came to Conner's over the Labor Day holiday with friends because they had $2 mimosas. The food was good. We were a little surprised when we arrived no one seemed to be aware of the drink special that had been advertised but they were very accommodating and did offer $2 mimosas!

This family-owned steak/BBQ venue was really tasty, using their own Bubb's Texas Style BBQ sauce.  Yum!  Everyone enjoyed their meal.  Our starters were Jalapeño Poppers and Tobacco Fried Onions. They were so good, and just want we needed.  We liked choosing the sides....Mac/ch, cinnamon apples, corn, green beans, cowboy beans, slaw...two sides for dinner, one for lunch.  The steaks and ribs were amazing.  The medium rare prime rib was spot on.  The Reuben was delicious. The ribs, and brisket sandwich was pull-apart tender.  The hamburger was a good ole burger.  This was a delicious meal after a long day of craft brew tasting.

Very tasty food and great portion sizes. Ordered the flat noodles, pineapple fried rice and garlic special chicken and everything was great. We only got takeout, although they were open for indoor dining. Online ordering was easy but the wait was 50-60 minutes on a Saturday night.

Great place to catch a game and have some drinks. This has definitely been one of my spots over the years! Great beer selection and friendly service. Big fan of the flatbread pizzas, specifically the spicy Thai pizza.

Crabby's seafood options exceeded my expectation as they were quite fresh. We ordered to share: 1) a dozen Cleveland Oysters, 2) Steamer Bucket (that came w/ cole slaw & mashed potato), and 3) the entire Bairdi Crab (that came w/ french fries & fresh veggies). Our most favorites were the Cleveland oysters, bairdi crab, french fries and cole slaw. Since the bairdi crab was the star of the show, I do not recommend the steamer bucket because the clams, mussels & shrimp were alright (nothing special). I would recommend just ordering bairdi crab w/ sides.

Excellent service! Our waiter was so attentive and friendly.

Rincon Beach Club is refusing to fully or partially refund any deposits even though Santa Barbara / Carpinteria is currently legally prohibiting weddings from taking place. They are incredibly inflexible regarding these circumstances. They offer the option for a later booking date, but are charging $5000-7000 more for a wedding on the later date. Their wedding contract and business policies are unconscionable. I would highly recommend that you avoid Carol and Rincon Beach Club at all costs and go with a more professional, fair wedding vendor.

First time at this location. My husband and I were seated and greeted quickly. My comments are not major but will impact future visits. 
1. My husband likes coffee with his breakfast and HATES sugar in the raw. It's just how it is. 
2. Ordered "million dollar bacon". Flavor was great just under done for me (will remember to order it crispy)
3. Ordered "lemon quinoa pancakes. Again tasted great but what I received was not what was described. Not a deal breaker but it seemed some short cuts were taken. 
Overall nice place. Much needed in our area.

It's an intimate German  restaurant with an incredible wait staff.  On our latest visit, the devour Indy menu was in effect.  Although the menu was small, it featured unique veggie treats and some award winning combinations.  The spicy mustard served with the house made pretzels is just spicy enough.  The brats are uniquely meaty and tasty.  The vegan dishes are creative and filling.  The beer is, well, the beer is very good. On our latest visit I ordered a craft cocktail that was bourbon based and I was not disappointed.  The eggplant sandwich was over the top good.

I waited until my second visit here to write a review and I am glad I did. Both times, the service was fast and great. The same goes with the food, between the shrimp rice dish, the shrimp spring rolls, and the brisket pho, I can confidently say the food quality at this joint is great! The parking is probably the biggest downside to both experiences, especially during lunch hour. I recommend giving this place a try for some pho or even noodle and rice dishes, just make sure you come outside of lunch hour if you want a place to park!

Not your average joes is a cute place and nice to go for lunch in suburban square, but beware it is average. It's nothing special and is overpriced for what you get. The grilled chicken sandwich is okay. Not really seasoned, just grilled chicken on a ciabatta. The location is very cute and the outside seating is perfect, but the food is okay.

Usually such a huge fan however the last two or three times has been mediocre . Maybe a chef change? 

Teriyaki beef and spareribs are definitely not the same or being cooked the same. Missing the old style. 

Even pasta salad was different. 

SO SAD I LOVED THIS PLACE

ClusterTruck came into my life when I started working downtown and I was blown away by the concept and the food. It was fast, high quality and delicious. And after 4 years those things still stand true. 

During this time of quarantine Cluster Truck has been an easy and wonderful way to mix things up. So when Yelp celebrated #yelpsbignightin I went for it! 

They always have a great selection of food from a variety of genres but that evening I was feeling the need for some comfort food. I went with their cheese quesadilla and Magoo's Eggrolls. No matter my order I ALWAYS get the egg rolls. They are my favorite!! Everything I have gotten from Cluster is always fantastic. I've had salads, breakfast, burgers, and thai food. All of it is great!

The one drawback to Cluster is the price. The delivery is included in the price of the food but I still think it is too high, even for the delivery convenience. ClusterTruck is definitely a splurge and luckily on this particular night I had a great coupon.

Extremely disappointing. We were really excited about this place. Our only vegan option was a salad without dressing. Dessert was uninspiring and the venue was cold. We wanted to like this place, but service was  just as bad as the food.
That food SMACKED!! On my mama that shit was good! I give it a 10/10 highly recommended

Came here for a vegan date night and will absolutely return!  Free self parking, which is always nice.  Upon entering, we were greeted by friendly smiles and not only a, "Hello, Welcome" but by an authentic, "We are so glad you decided to dine with us tonight" which was a nice change.  Our waitress, Jessica, was eager to share the menu with us after asking if this was our first time at True Food.  She made great recommendations, was attentive and always smiling :) She even told us that we seemed like a "fun" couple which made us smile.  The food was delicious - we got the Brussel Sprouts, Cauliflower (which was described accurately as "magical", by Jessica), the butternut squash pizza and the squash pie for dessert.  The rose-infused gin drink was also the bomb!  Overall, we felt great about what we were eating, enjoyed the service and appreciated the attentive, yet relaxed atmosphere.  Good vibes all around and will definitely visit again and suggest it to anyone asking for recommendations for healthy/veg/vegan food.  Thanks for the experience!

Absolutely horrible management.  Waited for 30min and sat 3 parties before us.  Said bar area was usually first come first serve but tonight a wait.  Sat a party in bar who came after us, because now there is no wait.  Clearly the manager has a problem managing her staff.  I called manager and she was no help.  Sounded like she was reading a script and was overwhelmed 

The Chili's team who responded below said they were sorry about how the food was.  Totally off subject...

I knew I had to check out Lucky's Last Chance after exploring their menu and discovering their creative burger selections.

After reviewing the menu. My heart was set on this one particular burger called the PB and bacon.Yupp peanut butter on a burger! I knew that I would probably like it because I enjoy sweet and salty food combinations.

The PB and bacon burger came with a double patty, it had peanut butter, fried onions, cheese and a jelly dip on the side. It was definitely delicious and huge. I enjoyed every bit of my burger. 

I also decided to order their fries and I don't know why I did that cause it was a complete waste. The fries tasted like it set under the light too long which I can't understand cause order and pick up took no longer than 20 minutes . It was just stale and tasteless. I was a little bummed about that being as tho fries are my ish!

Overall pickup and ordering was a breeze. I would order from Lucky's Last Chance. I just wouldn't get their fries again. Three and a half yelps!

I thought this place was pretty weird. I walked in on a whim and couldn't figure out if it was a dog shop or a knick knack shop or a sandwich shop because it seemed like a mixture of all three. The menu was pretty varied. The person working seemed surprised that I hadn't heard of the place before and claimed to have the best sandwiches in the city. My carry out order took a while to prep, so I had plenty of time to look around and become even more confused. Food was OK, but nothing amazing. I can't really think of a reason to return other than being very, very hungry and being stuck in that side of town.

We really wanted some oysters and happened to be walking around downtown so we headed over to Lucky Lobster. My boyfriend asked how fresh they were and the waiter joked about having to shuck them for us they were THAT fresh. We also ordered a kid's chicken tender meal for the little guy ($9 is ridiculous for a kids meal btw) and the grilled octopus appetizer. The oysters were terrible, tasted old like they had prob been sitting in water all week, the chicken tenders were over cooked, the fries were hard and had probably been refried multiple times (old) and the grilled octopus came out already cut up it seriously looked like they just handed us someone else's left over plate. It was really disappointing. Service was slow as well and they weren't all that busy for a Saturday night. Way overpriced for less then average food. Won't be back!

With a 4 star in Yelp, I thought this would be a good Japanese restaurant in St. Louis. I'm very, very disappointed! I ordered a few maki rolls to share as an appetizer, and the rice was soggy and mushy. My niece would always eat unagi donburi, and she ate 1/3 of the bowl and gave up eating because she didn't like the taste of it. I ordered their sake donburi, and ordered the large with 16 slices of salmon - it came, and I feel like I got jipped. 16 slices of salmon for $35 equals to 16 slices of salmon that was smaller than 1"x1" and it was paper thin. I would buy sushi grade salmon at home, and would be able to cut the fish like an actual sashimi slice. I'm speechless in the tiny slices of salmon sashimi for $35, and the menu said salmon and roe, but when I asked the waitress where the roe was... she said it doesn't come with it. It's definitely deceiving, and then after I told them it's not what the menu said and that is another reason I ordered it - she gave me a spoon of salmon roe. I honestly cannot say it was fresh, unfortunately. There was an after taste in the salmon roe. I've never experienced such an issue at any other Japanese restaurants. My aunt ordered the fish of the day, which was a Cod and it was so salty that she couldn't even finish it. The only good thing about this was the fact that my nephew had a great tamago maki there. Overall, the price for sushi doesn't equal to the quality and the amount that should be served.

I've only done take out. Most dishes have a kick of spice - if you really can't handle spice, pay attention to the spice levels on the menu. 

Dan dan - 5/5. They're heavy on the peanut butter so only get this if you like PB. I had a lot of mediocre dan dan dishes before.. this one really made me really crave dan dan noodles in the future. Sauce is thick and flavorful

The popcorn chicken - 3/5 I've had better at very authentic sichuan restaurants but it's not bad. It may be better if I could have tried it dine in and  it was crispier/right out of the kitchen

Lamb torn noodles - 5/5. The noodles are fat but doesn't seem hand torned (perfectly cut seeming) but that didn't bother me. Lamb and sichuan spices are always a great and this didn't dissapoint

Wings - 3/5. Not bad but nothing special

Fish pickled cabbage - 5/5. Not as spicy. Again, great spices

Overall, I was pleasantly surprised. The restaurant seems fancier and made me think the dishes would have been much more americanized. However, the traditional spices are there and I enjoy their play on it. Hopefully, I can try the cocktails there next year.

Portions are generous for take out too. Had enough for 2-3 meals.

Great food and great service.
However, we were shocked when they charged us 0.25 cents for a Tbs of mayo and on top of this 2.5% surcharge for using our debit card!!!!!
Wow who does that? 
We did tip our waitress 20% because she was so nice but we will not return and will share our experience with our friends.
What a shame to be so greedy, the food is so good!

Taking it to the next level. Altomontes continues to impress me with  new and different items. Their bakery produces amazing seasonal treats including special flavors of cannolis, and also offers gluten free items as well. The butcher shop dry ages meat themselves offering you amazing cuts of meat at prices you are not going to find at most other butcher shops. The hot bar now is continually fresh, and rotates things like wings, pastas, vegetables always making it a place to get a quick dinner.

What has taken Altomontes up a notch is that they now sell select Italian wines and beers making it one of the few places around where you can get food and alcoholic beverages all in one place.

Finally, the Altomontes special events group has started holding wonderful events including wine tasting, pasta making classes and tastes of food from different regions of Italy. Altomontes is a special place in the Doylestown community.

Been here twice in the afternoon now and LOVED it! Food is absolutely delicious! Service is exceptional! Staff is friendly, accommodating, and very helpful. They offer suggestions if you have no idea where to start, and everything was quick. 

A few customers showed up right at closing time, and the entire staff dropped everything to make sure they were ready to welcome and serve them no matter what! That speaks volumes for the managers and customer service. Great sense of community :)

My first time having Jim 'N Nicks and I wasn't that impressed. The brisket was a bit dry and the sides (mac n cheese and greens) lacked the depth I'm used to experiencing in good Tennessee BBQ. I will admit you won my one year old nephew over with the cheesy cornbread. 

I'll give you another try when I'm back in TN in the hopes of a better experience.

This place is a joke. 

The staff are friendly enough but rude / talking sh*t about each other in front of customers . 

Called an order in a head of time, they had not put it in. Which i would excuse but dont lie and tell me "it will be 5 minutes" . Cancelled our order Left after about 10 mins . There are plenty of awesome places to eat in Nola don't waste your time here
The food is absolutely delicious! I ate there for the first time yesterday. It's in an odd location and hidden but definitely worth a try! I 100% will be a regular customer!
I had a lot of doubts before I came here, but tbh i was pleasantly surprised. Not too bad...def not deserving of the 2.5 stars it has right now.

After visiting Thailand this summer, we've been searching for a place that was as authentic as possible, sand this place definitely hit the spot. 
My wife was dancing in her seat at the first taste of her Thai tea. 
We got 2 different pad thai (shrimp & pork), at a 1 & a 3 spice level, which were both delicious, though we do tend to like a bit more saucey-ness to our pad Thai. 
We had the Khao Soi, which was delicious, and had just enough heat to it. 
My only disappointment was the mango sticky rice, flavor was good, but the sticky rice was almost too sticky and more like glued together. 
Overall we'll definitely be returning soon!
easily best vietnamese joint in the area... general surrounding area of maybe 10-15 miles in either direction! everything ive had on this menu was good and the service is solid. keep it up Hen
Cutest little dining area with solid food and some of the nicest people on staff you've ever encountered. Always so pleasant to pop in here!

We happened on Bartaco after wanting to get some Mexican fare after all the chicken and burgers we've had this past week on our 1st trip to Nashville for some vacation amidst all this COVID stuff going on. 

When we arrived there was no wait which was great and the little street side restaurant was quaint and clean. We were seated at a nice sized table for the 6 of us and told we had to order via the phone....This is where things went awry. The app wasn't working and it was requiring me to sign in or create an account with email and phone number to just place an order...which was also more difficult for larger parties to order on one device without multiple bills and payments to make.

After having several problems and no assistance we finally caught a break and got the app to finally order out food and drink....only problem with this is also when they brign the food out - they just throw it on the table and you all have to guess as to what tacos are what and separate it out...very confusing and inconvenient. 

Food was tasty albeit a bit more expensive and certainly less convenient than even most other restaurants who are making you order at a bar or window and then bringing you your meals and drinks remembering who ordered what. We asked and this is a corporate mandate so disappointing to say the least with this experience. 

They did remove a Sangria that was much more red wine tasting than my wife had hoped as she is a true sangria drinker but this was after we had to put

Seems like a small dive place but needed to eat something late. Was staying at the Fairfield Inn Across the street and grub hubbed it. Pizza was really good. Crunchy crust. Cheese sticks were eh but would highly recommend

Found this place by accident, and I can honestly say this is the BEST pizza I've had since moving from New England 13 years ago. From the atmosphere to the service, everything about this place screams New York, and the food certainly did not disappoint. The slices are as big as your head, Deana is a doll, she explained the menu and the combos and Monique, our server was bright and helpful. If you know New York pizza, DEFINITELY check this place out. Kudos to the owner!
Waited an hour for food and bread. Food was cold when it came out. Over cooked shrimp. Undercooked potatoes. Flavorless grits.

This is my favorite fried chicken restaurant!! If you wanna get some Korean fried chicken, this is the best place in Philly. Also you can get the best draft beers too. My favorites are boneless crispy chicken with spicy level 2 sauce and Bulgogi Nachos. The chickens are perfectly cooked so these are really crispy. The place is really clean and the servers are nice too. You should try this!!

The perfect spot to go for drinks and a quick bite to eat! I had the buffalo cauliflower bites and the red strawberry margarita for happy hour! Very delicious!! The music was great but my only issue was half of the menu wasn't available to order and the servers excuse for that was "it's because it's Friday and we've had a busy week".. I guess that makes sense.

Can't believe I forgot to leave a review earlier. I'm a big Vietnamese dessert fan, and I've tried the Bambu in Philly, another one in NJ, and NYC but the Pennsauken location is by far my favorite. The drinks are always on point and the customer service is exceptional. 

On my recent trip (we drove over an hour to satisfy our cravings), I called about 45 minutes to closing and ordered about 16 drinks, the lady who took down my order was professional and I got all the drink exactly as ordered. 

All their drinks are amazing but a must try is the REFRESHER! None of the other Bambu has it!

Found this place on yelp when looking for somewhere to eat before flying out of the airport. (Only a 10 minute drive!) It was wonderful!!! I had read their story online and as someone who has an food/health issues I really appreciated their heart! It is a great atmosphere, friendly staff, and delicious food!! I had the bently burger with a lettuce wrap and an Affogato. The area it is located in is also a lovely place to have a little stroll.

Great views. Service was good. We waited about 15 minutes for a table and sat at the bar while we waited.

I ordered the Signature burger, which comes with crispy bacon, two slices of american cheese, and crispy onions. Comes with a pickle and really good French fries. 

My issue with this place is they only offer valet parking in their lot. Not validated. We ended up paying for parking in the beach lot on Courtney Campbell. I wouldn't go back based on the parking alone. I feel as though since people are dining there, then they should park for free.

A random chat with a girl at a restaurant bar led me to this place. Highly recommended. Her recommendation did not disappoint. A wonderful atmosphere, and spot on wine and dinner recommendations by Nicole. The crab cakes are amazing. The Constantino Cab Franc was as described. Deep, and full bodied. I'd love to return to sample other offerings on the menu. Nicole was attentive and personable. So happy that a random chat guided me to a wonderful restaurant. I will definitely return on my next trip to Philadelphia.

After my initial visit, this has become one of my favorite restaurants. I ordered my food to go, but next time I will consider dining in. The staff is extremely friendly and I always prioritize service above all else.

I ordered the rib tips dinner with macaroni and cheese, southern slaw, and garlic bread. The rib tips were tender and seasoned perfectly. I was not a huge fan of the macaroni and cheese, but I prefer mine with a little more cheese. There appeared to be so many delicious options on the menu. I will definitely return. If you are looking for delicious barbecue at excellent prices, this is your place.

We first knew about this place when we saw it in OC in Jersey two summers ago. And since then every time we are back there, we go. So-when we heard they opened in Philly, we were excited. Took our two boys there last night for dinner and they loved everything! We ordered 30 wings in 3 different kinds of sauces, dumplings, spicy funk taco, and a spicy pork rice bowl. 

The wings: the wings were delicious. Crispy, moist, and the sauce was just right. Not too heavy. They are small compared to the crazy big wings at Bonchon but that's fine by us. The crunch is actually better than Bonchon and the sauce not as dry as the wings at Bonchon which is good. Also their spicy wings were more consistent than the spicy wings at Bonchon where one wing's level of spicy can be very different from another wing.
Dumplings: we got the chicken. They were good. Not frozen dumplings but I think homemade. 
Rice bowl: it was a great mix of vermicelli noodles, greens, Korean spicy pork, a dumpling, and rice. A great mix of textures, flavors, and temperature. 
Spicy tuna taco: it was huge. I was expecting a small taco but it was huge. The tuna was flavorful and fresh. There was a brown sauce on there that was sweet but I think the taco would have been good without that sauce. They also served it with a spicy mayo sauce on the side. 

Service: you order at the counter and they call your name or bring the food to you. You put away your dishes, etc. with that said, the staff is very friendly, helpful with

I've now eaten at cafe Carmela twice, and overall the experience has been very positive! I've had the Margherita pie, wings, chicken cutlet sandwich, mozzarella sticks, and Don Cheech's Steak.

Pizza was good hot out of the oven, and all seem quality ingredients. Good crust, nice sauce, enough cheese. I expected more from the reviews, but there is much much worse in the city, it's a decent pie with quality ingredients. I'll be trying a few others soon enough, we will see if any blow me away, but this was good compared to most local Pizza Shops.

Mozzarella sticks, excellent! Crispy outside, completely melted inside, marina dipping sauce very good, fully recommend!

Chicken wings, I like that they fry the wings and they are very crispy, how I personally prefer my wings. Cucumber ranch sauce is very good! However, the spice rub they use (Rosemary, Lemon) was just a little too different for me personally. It wasn't bad by any stretch, and I imagine many people would enjoy, it's just not what I expected for my wings, but I do like that it's different than most wings you would get anywhere else.

Don Cheech's Steak, It is a very good Philly steak sandwich. They did not go sliced ribeye, they chop their ribeye. I would honestly be raving about this cheesesteak had I not had the sandwich below. It's a good large cheesesteak, and I like that they offer the cooper sharp option. Seeded Roll has a good good bite outside, fresh inside, and meat seems to be quality, no fatty gristle at al

I come here all the time and always have trouble parking.  Not enough space... However this review is not about that, my problem was the ladies room.... I visited the ladies room before shopping and when I went in I was told in a nasty attitude that they were cleaning the bathroom and I couldn't go....No apologies just attitude... Second time it's happened. . To management. . Clean your dam bathrooms before customers come in or at least get a crew without attitude....Not acceptable
Have ordered from here in the past but this time it was horrible. Soup tasted sour and the ingredients were unrecognizable. Cubes of fish like substance. Won't go back

We checked in on a Sunday afternoon with a party of eight and were seated right away.  Our server was very friendly and pleasant and kept us in drink refills.  I ordered the Caesar salad with an order of grilled shrimp.  I was happy to receive about twice the shrimp I expected which were grilled just right.  Excellent.  My partner ordered cajan chicked pasta and we both found the meal to be beyond our expectations for flavor.  Great.
Truly a unique NoLa experience. A menu filled with NoLa specialties, service with southern hospitality, and a live jazz band performs around the restaurant different halls.

I went to this drivethru. Convenient. A young man tried to take my order but was confused so 2 different girls took over. I wanted 2 Cold Brew with foam. I wanted it sweet and definitely not Pumpkin flavor. I ordered tall. I had not been to a Starbucks before on my own. Friends were always buying me coffee while I did them a favor. Getting the order almost correctly now. They were not served over ice but still good. The Talls were short squat cups, not Tall at all. The total price was 962. I rounded up to 12 with my tip. You know these kids are making Lousy wages at the drivethru. We drove away and I said to my husband Starbucks Stock Holders are LAUGHING all the way to the Bank. This is a MULTI BILLION dollar company. They could lower their prices so that MORE people could AFFORD it and INCREASE the wages of their young employees. They WON'T!!!! Maybe in a Perfect World. I seriously doubt that their employees can afford to buy the coffee they are selling. Just a thought.

So not ever having hotpot before, I came into this restaurant completely open minded.  At the end of the meal, I felt like I was smoky and full.  Smoky because you cook your own food at the table and full because I tried to eat all I could based on the all you can style menu.  You have three choices...hot pot, grilled meats, or a combo of the hot pot and meat. 

I decided to go with the meat and my wife went hot pot just so we could try a little of each.  With the hotpot you pick up to four different soup bases. My wife went with spicy originally.  Turns out it wasn't a great choice for her palate.  It was spicy in a way that your tongue goes numb! So she switched to the regular base,  which is a chicken broth (you can add spice via success they have at a bar). You then choose meats, veggies and other assorted items you basically cook sous vide in the broth.  She had noodles, wonton,  bok choy, fish cakes,  and a couple of other items I can't remember.  Overall, it was okay...just not something I would always eat (I can make Ramen with the same stuff at home). 

With the grilled meats,  I got korean style bulgogi, spicy pork bulgogi, and pork belly.  I went safe just to see how it was really going to be.  Notice I said korean style? Well... being Korean it definitely didn't remind me of my mom's cooking.   It was OK, but most of the meats were pretty fatty.  Sauces definitely added some flavor. 

At the end of the day,  I felt meh.  Wasn't bad, but wasn't good.  Just ok.  I f

Was fun & had a Nice dinner except overpriced on our vodka on the rocks - $29 - nothing was special about them except one drink had one olive. Great food and good service. Will be back, but might stress we are only ordering a simple drink. Maybe that's the rate they charge?  Not a deal breaker.

Not a huge fan of steak, but I LOVE steak from the Keg. I've had a few options, and they're always so good. I've also had their salmon, which was just ok. I guess it is a steakhouse after all. The appetizers are so good, I could order a few of them and be content. Lobster and escargot appies are insanely good. The twice baked potato is unreal. Servers are always pleasant.

I got the hot pot farmer's lamb. I love spicy food and it's rare for a restaurant to give me something hot enough to really hit the spot. This one did! Great flavors and heat. The cold pork belly appetizer was also tasty. And they were very accommodating of my Celiac and had a large number of options that could be prepared gluten free.

I have always been a fan of poke bowls and sushi, so when my friend told me about a place that made sushi burritos, I was ecstatic to try it. This food lived up to the hype from my friend. You can make your own sushi burrito, bowl, or salad. They also have a menu with premade combinations. In my burrito, I got spicy tuna, avocado, cucumbers, green onions, spicy mayo, and eel sauce. It was delicious! FYI, you can get your sushi burrito dusted in flamin hots if you want some extra spice. 

The inside is small, so I wouldn't really recommend eating there. The staff was very helpful. They gave suggestions and happily answered any questions my friends and I had. 

I would definitely recommend going to this place if you are in St. Louis. They definitely won't disappoint you!
Delicious house Margarita's! My shrimp and fish taco was very flavorful! The service was beyond friendly and just overall perfect! Thank you! Can't wait to come back!

Tonight we wanted to order something different so we ordered from this place off of grubhub(bad idea on the grubhub part). We wanted to go to this place but unfortunately quarantine had hit the weekend we planned to go. Anyway we both got burgers with cheese, tomatoes,lettuce, pickles and the regular condiments. When I say this is the best local burger,  fries and milkshake, I full-heartedly mean it! The burger was fresh and real meat!! The cheese that my boyfriend got was pepper jack and it actually tasted like it! The buns were FANTASTIC! Not soggy or hard/dry. Tomatoes tasted fresh. I'm a huge pickle person and I loved these pickles! The fries were tasty and not too oily and greasy. Perfect! I ordered a strawberry milkshake and it really hit the spot. Overall for sure a 10/10 food wise! I wish I had pictures but we ate it so fast I didn't get to take pictures. I will 100% be ordering again!!

Ruby Sunshine has good service and a friendly wait staff but everything else is basically a dumpster fire. 
-plastic drink ware 
-plastic plates
-cold bacon
-warm mimosa
-biscuits weren't cooked
-eggs weren't done all the way
-fried green tomatoes were inedible

Don't even try it. $60 for this glorious experience.

We were looking forward to a nice evening out. We had heard from a few people that Vecchia wasn't following Covid guidelines, but thought maybe they were exaggerations.  Tonight we arrived and were told only indoor seats were available. We agreed and were seated next to the kitchen. We were shocked that only a few employees were wearing masks in very tight quarters. Most were not wearing masks! We had a clear view into the kitchen and some of the cooks were vaping over the salads!  During covid!  We asked to be moved outdoors because of this and were told it would be an hour and a half wait. We ended up putting our masks on between bites because it we were shocked with the conditions.  We quick gobbled our food down, paid our bill and got out of there.  Why aren't they following guidelines? All restaurant employees are required to wear masks.They could clearly see we were uncomfortable and would not put on their masks.

The worst Imos ever. Our pizza was cold, our chicken strips were burnt, and we actually paid more than we should have. You would think that with all the other food places surrounding it, they would put more effort in their food and be great. Very disappointing.
Yummy for vegans, and everyone else  Food is amazing, fresh and healthy! What more can you ask for?

The atmosphere is fun, the food is delicious and creative and the service is friendly and quick! I really enjoy the benedicts and the fact that they offer an option on the menu to try three different kinds at once. The breakfast margarita is so tasty and will certainly give you a slight brunch buzz :-)

They have news hours and pick up and curb service only, however food was great. They looked to be using virus precautions. Parking lot was packed but they had a lot of working working hard and didn't hCe to wait long at all.

I love C&C Creamery! I've been going here since I was a tiny tot. We always order our birthday ice cream cakes from here, and recently discovered that they make cakes from almost any of their hard ice cream flavors or you can just stick to the traditional chocolate/vanilla or even chocolate/chocolate. They are always super nice and their recent COVID restrictions, though strict, are very reassuring. Their homemade ice cream is always delicious and they make my all-time favorite flavor, pumpkin spice cookie!
If I could give 0 stars I would. This quality of the food that this honey grow serves is a disgrace. The rice noodle that I ordered were dry, broken, and greasy. I will not be back.

We came here with my cousin who is a NOLA local. The staff was amazingly friendly and accommodating and the food was AMAZING! Everyone in our party got different entrees (I got crawfish etouffee, my Dad got jambalaya, my Mom got shrimp creole, and my best friend got the sampler with jambalaya, gumbo, and red beans and rice, and my cousin got blackened chicken.) Parking was a bit of a nightmare which is to be expected when eating anywhere in the Quarter. But 10/10 would eat there again!

I usually don't write reviews but this experience was pitiful. I've been here before but the food was terrible this time. The beignets tasted like they were old and fried a second time to add a little heat. Then we ordered an eggs black stone. First time the English muffin was burnt and unable to cut it with my knife (maybe old English muffin). Asked for the food to be recooked. The second time, me and my mom took a bite. It was sour. The tomatoes were rotten and old were they were disintegrating/spongy. Decided to leave the restaurant still hungry. No apologies from waitress or manager.

Horrible service. Waited for half an hour to get the appetizer and another hour for the remaining food. Even dessert took time to be served. They had 2 servers on a busy friday evening. Avoid if you can.

Delicious food and great prices. The staff was friendly and helpful, and it is family run. The chicken enchiladas are amazing! Have ate here 3 times for lunch. You can't go wrong. Salsa bar is also very well made and complex flavors.
Delicious , well prepared, authentic Indian dishes.  Nothing on the menu has disappointed.  Best Briyani I've ever had.  We love this place!

Great lunch take out specials or dinner here. Got general Taos chicken with white meat and no bread on it- they are very accommodating to changes and very tasty! Love the walnuts they add to the general toas in the lunch special. Highly recommended

Little Sheep is officially now an AYCE! They revamped the front to a buffet bar where you can pick from small appetizers, rice, noodles, vegetables, seafood, and dipping sauces. It was clean when we went. We did notice that a lot of the originally choices (esp meat and seafood selection) have been erased off the menu but I guess this is the downside of being an AYCE now. 

I really love how they have service cards now (green/red sides) in case you need something or you are good! The price is cheap around $25/person. The broths still taste the same. The free ice cream at the end hit the spot. Taro or black sesame were the choices.

Only cons were that the vegetables weren't washed. I attached a photo of our dirty bok choy!!! Our hotpot stove wasn't turned on and the server never noticed and tried to add our food in for us. We turned the burner on ourselves. Also, it took ages for them to refill our broth at one point even though we flipped the sign to red (need help), we could almost see the 2/3 of our ladle!

I checked out this new spot for a girlfriend's birthday. First impression of the space: the ambience is different but kind of fun. Dim, blue lighting...almost like sushi restaurant vibe. The menu is decent, a spin on classic dishes. I ordered the Thai peanut seitan wings and the jalapeño cheesy grits. My friend has the pork shoulder sandwich and brussel sprouts. Though I really loved the grits, I was not into the wings. Perhaps just not my thing. Also the blue cheese dressing with it was very watery. The pork shoulder sandwich looked good, but the brussels seemed a bit lame. I also enjoyed a good glass of Reisling. Our server was friendly and very attentive. He gave us dessert on the house in honor of my friend's birthday. Overall, I didn't dislike Fairview and think it is definitely worth a try. I will say, for it to join my rotation, id need the smaller sized menu to rotate and the prices to drop.

Came here for a late lunch, not crowded. Food came out pretty quick. There's a lunch special until 3pm. Got the LA kalbi dolsot and  the soon dubu/Kalbi combo. Even though it lunch; the portions were pretty decent. The dolsot vegetable sauce into the rice made the dish pretty flavorful. Kalbi was cooked well. Soon dubu was also good. Got a 2 (mild)- is actually pretty mild. Other Korean restaurants I've been to; mild is still pretty spicy. I would probably get a 3 next time. 
There's plenty of parking in the lot. 
Good service.

Another business in Safety Harbor full of people crowding outside and no mask rules enforced. I want to eat, not go somewhere to catch a virus. 

Sorry, but the food is not much better. Tried it a few times before the virus hit to give them the benefit, sadly it was just not as good as food I can get 10 minutes away. That and they ran out of sides...was much better at the old location.

Came here in 1/19/2021 for Schitt's Creek trivia. Was super excited for this event. It was well advertised through Facebook. 

We showed up early to grab a spot. It was pretty packed but we were able to find a spot outside with bench seating, a low coffee table, and a few chairs.

It was a bit chilly out that night and they had the tall heaters outside but they weren't on. My friend went inside to ask a staff member if they could turn a heater on and move it closer to us. The staff member came outside and turned it on but moved it closer to another group that didn't ask for it. My friend went back inside to ask about this and when I walked in the staff member was yelling at her saying "I can't make everyone happy!" Eventually he came outside to move it closer to us. 

We had a waitress in the beginning who took a few drink orders and delivered those drinks but never came back to take more drink orders for those who arrived later or food orders. After about 30 minutes we went to find her at the bar and asked if we could place food and drinks orders. She stated she would be over soon. After about another 20 minutes she still had not come back. The manager happened to walk by and we questioned about ordering food and drinks and how we've been waiting at list 45-50 minutes to do so. He immediately took our drink orders and gave us a round of drinks on the house. Then the waitress came over finally to take our food orders. 

Disappointing service unfortunately. It's hard to come b
I must say that I have been twice in a week and they do not disappoint. Great customer service and fast. The tacos and burritos are authentic. I can't wait to go back by.

Service slow. Lentil soup was brought to the table, we did not order, bacon was fatty and not cooked. Ordered shredded beef enchiladas with green sauce, received an enchilada plate with red sauce, waiter walked away and didn't return for 10 minutes. Food was bland, beans watered down.

Enormous selection of mid-grade to super premium tequilas (no cuervo gold here)!
Excellent margaritas & tasty food. Friendly staff! A real find off Broad Ripple Avenue!

The restaurant was recommended by concierge.  It was literally just blocks from our hotel.  The restaurant is charming and harkens back to a more elegant past.  We decided to have the D'Hote menu option which is appetizer/entree/dessert.

My soup was delicious as was the bread pudding.  The far and away champion of the meal was the entree: shrimp and grits.  The shrimp were plump luscious gulf shrimp on a bed of grits.  I love grits but never have had any like these.  It was almost like a risotto.  The tomato and peppers were a delightful pop of flavor to an already amazing dish.

The Lark may be my favorite restaurant in Santa Barbara!!!

Decided to celebrate my anniversary dinner here and it was a great choice! I was greeted with rosé and a personalized card from the restaurant which was a nice touch. 

The complimentary popcorn is so flavorful, I can't grasp the seasonings but feel free to ask for more because you will want more!

Ordered: 

- Big Sur ($14) - California gin, lime, passionfruit, amaro angeleno, lager - really refreshing and tasty!

- Crispy Brussels Sprouts ($13) - the best brussels sprouts I've ever had! I couldn't stop eating them. If you like sweet, you will definitely enjoy them too! 

- Little Gems 'Wedge' ($16) - not a fan of blue cheese but didn't even taste it. The spicy walnuts really make the salad!

- Hand Cut Tagliatelle Pasta ($26) - amazing pasta with a slight kick. 

- 8oz Creekstone Prime Hanger Steak ($42) - I wasn't too impressed with the steak as it was a little bland. Looking back I should've just ordered the ribs. 

Parking - is only street parking (on State street)

TIP - definitely make a reservation on TOCK. 

Overall - I was very satisfied with my experience at The Lark and can't wait to come back the next time I'm in SB. 

PLUS - this is 100th Yelp review! Woohoo!

Hidden gem. So happy to have found this place. The only good Chinese food that I've had in Nashville! I got the sesame chicken and it's good! The fried rice is okay but not my favorite. I really enjoyed the wonton soup. I got just two large pieces of broccoli with my meal - wish there were more veggies but next time I'll just get a side of them.

Ah. My favorite food truck in University City. This is my go to place for lunch and it's definitely bang for your buck! They did raise their prices by 25¢ this year but it's till very much worth it. 

I always get Mapo Tofu on Fried Rice with a Fried Egg. The Mapo Tofu isn't exactly the typical Mapo Tofu you get in restaurants, it's more of a stir fried tofu with pork and bamboo sprouts. Their fried egg though is the best fried egg I've ever had. The center is perfectly runny yet the outside is crunchy. 

The Potato Beef with extra vegetables, Fried Fish Garlic Sauce, and Eggplant in Black Bean Sauce with beef are also solid choices. I tried the Chicken Leg with Rice a couple times but while my friends swear by it, I found the chicken to be slightly undercooked. 

I also love chatting with the cook. He told me they've been here for over 30 years and it's clear that they've been successful for so long because their food is affordable and amazing. I totally recommend trying a lot of different dishes and deciding on which one you like best. 

Oh and don't forget to call in so you can avoid the long lines!

Go ahead...speakeasy to me. This classy yet rustic jazz lounge attracts a high end crowd, with a hometown vibe. I love the whole speakeasy movement that is growing. Yet this little Jazz club feels authentic and the staff is very welcoming. Maybe because my name was on the list and the ticket to the show I went to see was priced at  more than your average cover. But I would pay it again and gladly to support the local music scene in Nashville. 

There aren't enough Jazz spots in town, so I was delighted to walk into a swanky and well lit space with ambient decor. It's very moody yet sultry and the food is divine. 

I reached for the starter menu, but when I saw that it was so reasonably priced, I had to get desert as well. I felt like I had been given a home cooked meal. The smaller portions on the starter menu are enough to fill you up for hours. It's all pretty hearty food so you don't need a lot. I ordered the spicy crawfish gumbo, and it warmed me up enough on the inside to make me consider giving size-able gifts to all my acquaintances this year for the holidays. But after I tried the bread pudding drizzled in bourbon sauce...I was ready to call them all family! 

Oh wait...did you want to hear about the music? Sorry I've been thinking about that bread pudding for days now and I got distracted. But I'm back now I promise. Jazz..,that's right, Jazz...

The piano player was the best piano player I've seen in a very long time. Its Nashville and We get spoiled here. We get to

UPDATE AS OF 8/23/19: Morton's GM reached out to me to apologize for the service fail. I'll report back after our next visit.

Epic service fail last night. We've dined at this Morton's quite a bit, but never experienced such poor service. We were seated, and the waiter assigned to our table was engrossed in conversation with the diners at the table next to ours. That convo lasted about 20 minutes; during that time, no one stopped by our table, we weren't offered water, nada.

When he came by, he wanted to start taking orders with one of the gentlemen diners. As is usual in Nashville, we asked if he'd care to take the female diners' orders first. He said "no".

After taking our order, we saw him again 15 mins later with one appetizer. We thought that, surely, the others would be out directly thereafter. Unfortunately, that was not the case. After waiting another 20 mins (and letting the salad sit on the table), he showed up with the rest of the apps (EXCEPT the special $45 scallop appetizer; how the heck did he forget that?), all of our entrees and all of our sides. He wanted to leave all the food (which was a silly suggestion, since all of that food wouldn't have fit on our four top). 

He left the apps, and we thought that the special app would be right out. 15 mins later, it finally came. 

At the end of the meal, I gave the server my Landry's frequent customer number to redeem a $50 credit. He came back to the table and told me that it was applied ... but one look at the

I order delivery and it literally arrived 25 minutes after I ordered, very hot.  and this was from roxborough to East falls.  That is so quick!

Got the Hawaiian and meat lovers. Very good

I'm so confused how this place has any good reviews. The tables outside are on top of each other, there is no social distancing while waiting and people weren't wearing gloves. I did not feel safe dining here. Also, the tacos did not taste fresh and were cold. The taco shells weren't even toasted and just tasted gummy. The rolls were good, but that was the only positive.

I want to give it 4 stars. The temperature was lukewarm. I ordered a crepe, 2 eggs, sausage and home fries.
The crepe was "open" not closed. So when it was covered with the cream it stuck to the plate. Kinda disappointed. Was still tasty. Was a great portion. The sausage was way too greasy, hard pass on that. I'd probably go with a standard breakfast next time. Just eggs and toast

Food is always quality. Atmosphere is always lively and pleasant. The establishment keeps up with cleaning. However, the service seems to lack. I've had the wrong order three times in a row. Servers would probably benefit from slowing down just a couple of extra seconds or delegate help to ensure decent service. It was impossible to even get an extra plate/napkins after getting my food last time because we didn't see our server for literally more than 5 seconds. Also, the last few times I've been to el burro I've been with a group of 3 or more. It's never fun to flag a server down when you get the wrong order in front of a group. I will likely be back (not really by personal choice at this point), but it would be a much more pleasant experience if I actually walked out paying for what I ordered next time.

It wasn't bad but it wasn't good. 
A little pushy but the food was good. I had to explain my order 5 times and it was still wrong when I got it home.

Our dinner was delicious. The Brussels sprouts were amazing and I don't like Brussels sprouts. I got the stout braised short ribs and they were absolutely delicious!! My husband got steak frites and he enjoyed them. We also got a meat and cheese plate appetizer and a chocolate dessert, all delicious. I would definitely recommend it and return. I would like to try the brunch next time! Go!

I really think this restaurant misses the mark. The kids did not enjoy the food .... no sodas ...,the food service is beyond SLOW. Not something that works with hungry kids. Even the adults in the group did not enjoy the food.

It doesn't look like much on the outside but when you walk in it is beautiful!!!!!. The decor is gorgeous it makes you feel so comfortable. My food did not take long to come out. Before bagging it up to go she showed me my food to ensure everything was to my liking and she offered me condiments. The fish was so crunchy and flavorful. The grits were good as well. I can't wait to try another item.

I'm in town for the weekend and I was looking for some fresh vegan food to settle in with tonight. Got the jackfruit on a bowl and it was SO good. The rice cooked with coconut milk is insane. When I checked into the hotel-- the clerk asked me what I had in the bag that smelled so good.  It did not disappoint. I'll be going again before I leave out of Nashville! This is a new go to.

On Saturday 7/25/20 I placed an order for 2 pizzas  at 6pm it's now 9:30 and still hasn't arrived, I've called the restaurant multiple times, all being quickly ushered off the phone and lied to about the arrival time. Very unprofessional service :(

I usually have a good experience at this location but the last time I went I did not. The cashier/ order taker David was rude from the very beginning.  When I asked over the speaker if they had kool-aid, he laughed.  That made me upset.  To make matters worse he was just rude, I sat at the window with the money outside of the window and I felt as if he purposely took an extra amount of time to retrieve the money. Last but most important they charged me for baked beans and I did not receive them. When I attempted to call, no one answered the phone. Probably will not return to the east location.

I am so disappointed in multiple ways.

I was excited to try Thai Am because my usually spot is closed on Sunday and we wanted Thai. We ordered Pad Thai with tofu and veggies, and asked for no eggs because we wanted a vegan meal. We ordered take out, drove all the way up there to Thai Am for pick up, only to be super disappointed. There was little to no tofu in each order; and the little bit of tofu was fried and over done to be dry and gross. The veggies were nothing special. The noodles were way overcooked, mush, and broken up all into small pieces. This could have all maybe been overlooked, but we paid $30 for most the two dishes.

I called to let them know there was barely any tofu in either dish, and I was confused why we paid extra, especially after asking for no egg the tofu could have been a substitute. This is besides the point really, I'm more upset by how it was handled. I was told there is no way the tofu was missing, and I let them know there was very little tofu and it wasn't cooked well. I was told to take a pic and send it to a cell, and then they would hang up and cal back. They called back and I could hear the cooks or someone in the background arguing against what I was saying. I was then told they only give 2 pieces of tofu which is why it's a $2 up charge. 

Anyway, money besides the point with this up charge. I work in customer service, and we give someone the benefit of the doubt. I could have called and told them the whole dish was bad, which I didn't.

I recently attempted to dine at the Olive Garden at 5410 E Broadway Blvd, Tucson, AZ  85711. Unfortunately Jennifer, who claimed to be the restaurant manager, ruined our birthday dinner celebration. In these trying times, it's the little restaurant outings for birthday celebrations that mean the most. Jennifer ruined it for us based on comments that were unfounded. More specifically she discriminated against our group based on comments that were clearly a joke. My friend mentioned how we were very excited to have a great dinner and drinks but Jennifer refused service to our table because of allegations that two of the people in our party were "too drunk". These people, while they had had drinks prior to attending an Italian dinner, we're far from "too drunk". I would advise this manager to insead take the time to evaluate groups based on actual behavior than comments made in passing. She was extremely off putting. We are a young group, and to be discriminated against based on our age will not encourage us from going to any Olive Garden establishment ever again. On a side note, Jerome, our server was very accommodating. His service was the only redeeming factor. Jennifer should be held accountable for our service tonight and is the sole reason why we walked out without being served.

One star is only because of the person at the cashier. He was extremely rude to a simple question I asked about deserts being gluten free. He was not only rude by the words he used but very disrespectful, he forgot he was talking to a customer and a lady. Though the food is tasty, I would recommend folks not to visit this place if they can't hire people who can be respectful.
I could have made a scene though I didn't want to put that person on the spot. I have not experienced this behavior which was very demeaning.

After waiting in the drive thru for 20 min for my Very Berry Milkshake, it was warm and completely melted. Not only that is wait all over the outside of the cup, wasn't given any napkins of course. So I parked and went inside. After waiting a few minutes the lady said she would replace it. I got the new one, walked outside and it was chocolate. So I go back in, I ask for my money back. These shakes are over $4! After waiting a snotty lady came and gave me my money back. So rude to ME. Customer service is dead. This is overpriced for what you get and the services sucks.

My husband and I love this chain restaurant.  We seek them out every time we're near one. The prices are a little high but the portions are HUGE  and we usually have leftovers to take for another meal. The staff couldn't be friendlier especially our waiter last night, Ryan.  Just wish they had a location closer to where we live, central Texas.  My favorite is the ham steak breakfast but to be honest I've never had a hard meal here

Everything went perfectly for my last few visits here.  The drive thru, ordering, paying and pick up were fast and received all my items.  This McDonalds serves many people and the workers do a fantastic job.
Seriously some of the yummies food! The crab Rangoons are delicious and the Pho is absolutely scrumptious...basically a warm hug in a bowl!

We had some time to kill before an appointment at Costco tire, so found this place in the mall across the street.  I deduct one star because even though they had an outside seating area, the area was closed.  So was indoor dining.  Take out is all they do right now.  The menu of dim sum and ramen sounded so good, we decided to order and go eat in the car.  Glad we did.  The Ramen was OUTSTANDING.  It was absolutely the best I have had since leaving the West Coast.  I can't say enough.  

The broth and ingredients were perfectly prepared.  We ate everything down to the last drop!  It was packaged so that the broth and noodles were separated to keep them from getting mushy.  Even though we were pretty much tailgating on the fly, it was pretty easy to slide everything into the broth container and mix up to eat.   We will definitely go back and next time maybe try some dim sum.

I tried the new Chicken Bacon Chipotle flatbread pizza, and it was delicious! The ingredients were fresh and tasty; the crust was light but not too crunchy. The service was fast even though we came at lunchtime on a Saturday. The staff was courteous, the food was hot and now I have a new favorite dish for Panera. 
I was concerned it might be slightly too small of a serving size because the price was about $9 so I ordered a completely unnecessary chocolate chip cookie. The pizza takes up the full plate that they use for a soup and sandwich order. I only ate about half the pizza.

my caesar salad had a lot of dressing but hardly any flavor, kraft makes a better caesar dressing. the fish was good, wanted a bit more sauce and the italian potatoes were inedible.  meh all the way around. st. louis style provel pizza served here. i should have known better before we walked in the door.
So So food although the service was Good. Atmosphere was fine but if your looking for real cajun look somewhere else.

This place was amazing! We came here while visiting based on a recommendation from someone and weren't disappointed. 

I wasn't sure if I should expect a Popeyes or Chick Fil A. This place was neither and in a league of their own. The chicken strips were battered in a very good batter that had a lot of flavor. The chicken wasn't over cooked at all, either. The French fries weren't anything to get excited about, but the yummy chicken strips and Cane Sauce made up for it. 

My only complaint is that they don't have one of these in Sacramento where we live!
So good.  Yummy. Thank you.  I alway got desserts #3 my favorite. And I order one time 17 order for my friend at work.  They love it a lot
We're very disappointed.  We ordered at 8:20 and it's 9:40 and STILL don't have our food. We've checked on it twice. And keep being told it's being worked on... and not politely either :(

We ate dinner for the first time at Pemrose on the 4th of July before heading down to the fireworks. I made reservations on OpenTable and we were able to choose indoor or outdoor seating upon arrival. The ceiling fan in the outdoor patio provided a great breeze. Both my husband and I each ordered the 1/4 lb Lobster Roll with fries and it did not disappoint. It was one of the best lobster rolls we've had. (We have not had them on the east coast though!) the bread was nicely toasted and there were large chunks of lobster. The flavor was delicious. The shoestring-like fries were crispy and didn't even need to be dipped in anything. I had also ordered the crab and corn chowder to start and it was flavorful and full potato, andouille sausage and corn. Our server was great and the atmosphere was excellent. I would definitely return to Pemrose.

The owner of this business offers free meals to unemployed or underemployed hospitality industry workers during the COVID-19 public health emergency, both in Reno and Carson City. This includes, but is not limited to, restaurant, bar, casino, hotel, hair and nail salon, barber shop, fitness, and special event, and sports event personnel. The owner formed a group called Nevada Hospitality Industry Partnerships (Nevada HIP) to make this happen. He assembled a group of local food industry volunteers, taking no profit, to prepare meals at the lowest cost. In the first two weeks of this program, the team served over 630 meals, feeding approximately 1,900 people. 

Here is the local article:

https://carsonnow.org/story/05/05/2020/hospitality-industry-partnerships-expands-meal-distribution-carson-city-union-thurs

As a former pizza shop employee in South Lake Tahoe, I jumped at this. I am thrilled they are offering this program, as there are many people in need. I have gone here every time.

In Carson City, they offer a meal Thursdays and Saturdays from 4 PM to 6 PM behind The Union (Old World Coffee Lab) on Curry Street in Carson City to the first 100 people. They set up right by the back gate of the patio by the sidewalk, and you just park somewhere and walk up to pick up your meal in a to-go box or carton. Vegan and vegetarian options are available. There is never a line. Social distancing protocols are in place, and the meal is made in a sanitized kitchen at this business with

I was told that the old location of this place was awesome.  I can see the potential here (hence the extra star) but the lack of effort is inexcusable.  2 out of three sandwiches were burned beyond even being edible.  The garlic fries were VERY obviously cooked, left out to get cold and then recooked.  You can't recook fries.  You end up with a weird film in your mouth and an awful taste.  Would have been a great meal if it wasn't so carelessly put together.  I'd ask for my money back, but my sandwich was the one that wasn't burned..  soup was just ok

Checked out BYG for dinner and was pleased with what I found. I first have to say that the wait staff was very attentive and everyone appeared to be hustling, which is a refreshing change from when it was Love's. (Not sure how it compares to Nueva since they were in and out before I ever visited). I understand that the menu will be increasing soon, but I was still satisfied with the selections and the food was good for what we had. It was also served fast and piping hot. I had the wings, and do need to be a bit critical of the size, which was a bit small for paying $10 for ten. The flavor was good, garlic-parm, but could have had a bit more 'zing' on the garlic. Also had a side salad and it was a good portion and presented nicely. We sat in the dining area and though it was nice and clean with tables well spaced, it seemed a bit drab with the gray walls. Perhaps a few more pieces of wall decor is in the works? All in all, I enjoyed my visit and will be back again soon.
I have no idea what these people with 1,2 or even 3 stars are taking about. Great little diner, great service. The food came out fast and the portions are very generous. Highly recommend.
Stopped by on the way through STL. Really enjoyed our food and the sauces they had to offer. It was great that the pick up was contactless and we ordered online.

Best poke ever. They catered for us at work and they did an awesome job with wrapping each meal individually. The food was beyond tasty and fresh. The regional manager, Mike is extremely helpful, accommodating and generous. 
I highly recommend this place.
Lulu's is hands down our favorite local coffee shop! The cinnamon chip scones are our favorite!

I'm obsessed! The Cuban sodas are yummy and the food is delicious! I had the ropa Viejo today. The meat was tender and everything was so flavorful. Seasoned to perfection. The first two times I went with the Picadillo which is also totally amazing! This might just be my favorite restaurant ever. It's that good! It helps that the service is quick and when you're ready you're not stuck waiting forever.

All the deliciousness here is exciting! It's definitely not a budget friendly location but sooooo worth the money! You definitely get your money's worth. The service has always been great! Waiters are attentive & very responsive. The meats are delicious! & all the salads, soups, breads (especially the cheese bread they bring out to the table) are great pairings to the meats. Seriously... the pão de queijo is life! The best thing in the world! Have been there several times now & will continue to go back!

This McDonald's can not get their act together. For 20+ years, this location has been horrifically incompetent. Wrong orders, burnt fries, missing items... I have issues here EVERY SINGLE TIME I visit. I've been patient & specific: requested better fries, asked for everything I ordered... this McDonald's still fails every time... often in spectacularly new ways. It's obviously a training issue and no one at this location has cared in more than TWENTY YEARS. In spite of this McDonald's being closest to my house, I'll patronize the better-staffed location on Hillsborough Ave that offers infinitely better service. I just can't waste more time or money at this McDonald's.

Went here one night since it is close to our home.  We've heard good things and my boyfriend loves craft beer so we thought it would be worth a try.   

Food was over priced and lacked flavor. It could have been an off night for them, but given prices I doubt we will go back.  I think their draw is their view and drinks, but again even the drink menu is limited.  

Servers were nice, but awkward.  Almost like they do not wait tables regularly.

Not your average pizza place. There slices and salads are fantastic and they are very amenable to customizing dishes. Moreover, the folks behind the counter are super friendly and eager to please. Ambiance is the perfect combination of super casual but with comfortable seating to hang out with friends or family. Only wish they delivered for free!
Amazing coffee & pumpkin bread! Can't wait to be back in the area to stop by again! Such a cute little coffee shop!

Out of chicken at 9:30. The person taking the orders told me they were out and that it takes 25 minutes to cook chicken and....well that's when I drove away and went to Taco Bell. If you aren't going to serve your product til 10 then close early.

Great family owned place. The menu offers variety of scrumptious choices. Pancakes were fluffy and delicious. Eggs Benedict were done to perfection. Staff was friendly and cappuccino was excellent! You will not be disappointed.
Have gotten a variety of rolls and such from here and it's always so fresh and delicious! It helps that it is ready for pick up pretty fast too!

Delightful offerings for brunch and very creative.  Outstanding location to ponder on the river and enjoy the folks transiting the Boise Greenbelt, especially with the patio seating.  Very nice servers.  Parking a little bit of a challenge if you drive there.  The best way to get there is to walk/ride on the Greenbelt.  Bar available with a wide selection of local brews.
Horribly overcooked, to tough to chew. Side bar was old and stale. You need to know nothing else.

I have never been disappointed here! GREAT food and good staff! They are going a good job under new COVID guidelines as well. Plenty of hand sanitizer available and they were clearly cleaning tables, high chairs/boosters, and other high contact areas. Highly recommend.
Quiche & salad was flavorful & delicious!! Beautiful day when we went and enjoyed the outdoor patio. Server was very helpful and pleasant.

We stopped in to Corner 17 last night for the first time. I was shocked to see how busy it was at 8pm on a Monday night! That's a good sign immediately. Our server was friendly and explained the different items on the menu accurately. I ordered a mango bubble tea to drink. I'm not exaggerating when I say it's the best bubble tea I've ever had. Creamy with the right amount of sweet aftertaste. We started with the pork/cabbage dumplings which were phenomenal. Next we had Kung Pow Chicken and Hongshao Pork. The pork belly in the pork dish was cooked perfectly and the chicken was just the right amount of sweet. We also ordered the hand pulled beef noodle soup. We added some chili sauce to it which was delicious. We decided to finish with the Honey Dew Fluffy Ice. We ordered a small to share because the medium looked huge on another table but we decided to order a medium next time because it was so good! It was sweet but also refreshing. I've never had anything quite like it before! Our server packed our leftovers for us which is a nice touch and we definitely have enough leftovers to last 2-3 more servings which helped offset the cost. We will be back soon!

I stopped in once when I was getting a flat tire plugged down the street and now I'm grateful for that screw in my tire. The staff are friendly and helpful and the food is delicious. I keep going back for the pupusas which are delicious and a hell of a deal. I usually have a weird aversion to cornmeal based foods, but these are so good. I do like cheese, and the pupusas with cheese do not skimp. The loroco y queso, frijol y queso, and pupusa a la Mexicana are my favorites. They usually have a selection of aguas frescas too with some flavors you might not find elsewhere.

I love this little place. I've been here a few times with my husband and their sushi is always delicious and service is always pleasant. 

I came in today for lunch and ordered their lunch special - 2 rolls for 9.95 and this included salad and miso soup. You can also do 3 rolls for 12.95. 

I ordered the spicy tuna and angel roll. The angel roll has cooked tuna and the roll is fried. I actually thought it would be raw tuna and outside fried. I'm not a fan of cooked tuna but this one was not bad if you prefer cooked sushi rolls! 

Their crab Rangoon roll is the best! I honestly forgot about it during my visit today and was sad I didn't order it! Next time! 

COVID: 
The employees all wear masks and they kept all guests with one table between everyone.

Very delicious!! Husband and I came in and the staff was so friendly. I wanted to try the flauntas and pupusas. My husband had the burrito. The food was so flavorful. The price was pretty reasonable. Definitely will come back again for the corn and horchata.

Coming from a person who doesn't often get Chick Fil A, I will never turn one of their sandwiches down. The outside breading is oh so nice and crunchy giving you a sample of the goodness you are about to receive. But the chicken doesn't waver even after such a good intro. It's not wet, it's not stringy, it's a perfect balance. Even as you keep eating through the burger you still get crunches of breading making a perfect balance. By the time your done you will want more. My only problem with this sandwich is that there are crunchy spots through out it, making it possibly unappealing to one of a weak stomach. You have 2 options, a plain sandwich with a pickle, or a sandwich with toppings, which is something most restaurants don't do, so if you want one just plain, just order one with out the pickle. With toppings, well you get the idea. The fries are lovely as well but I believe they undersalted them due to the higher volume of potato. They applied the amount of salt for a smaller, normal sized fry, making it unbalanced. And finally the chicken nuggets, a perfect ending to a perfect lunch, nice and crunchy with good chicken inside. Overall a 8/10 4/5 or a B+/A-.

I know, I know. It's a chain.... not super inventive or unique. That being said, if you just want a decent steak and service without being pretentious- this is the place for you. I enjoy an occasional drink special or the early dine menu on a busy week night and don't want to think too hard, this is a good choice. Server Mariah was friendly and fast. Managers Megan and jess both stopped by to make sure everything was ok and appeared to be genuine. Like I said, it's a chain, but as far as chains go, it is more than solid. Lastly, I ordered a salad to go that was correct and quick.

Super friendly and good local food.  Pizza was delicious and cheese is creamy and stretchy the way it should be.  House handmade garlic knots are worth trying but there good so don't fill up before your pizza.  

This might be our new go to pizza place.  The chocolate chip cookies are also delicious!!
